_comment: ARMING-ONLY scenario for the operational envelope's arming guarantee (>=99% of arm() attempts reach ARMED within 3.0s): the same two bidirectional motors as two_channel_divergent_600 (channels 1 and 3, separate PIO blocks), but throttle stays 0 for the whole run, so nothing spins. Arms, holds zero for 3s while the harness keeps sampling replies, then disarms. The result that matters is the 'Armed after Nms' line, which scripts/run_scenarios.py judges against its 3.0s bound; the 3s hold only confirms the ESCs keep replying after ARMED. Not a motor-behaviour test - use two_channel_divergent_600 for that.
